label: GRIN — counts + response times (experimental)
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Adds SFT architecture and timing parameters from a simplified ballistic simulator; it is not a full LBA choice model. These weights come from a generator that has since been retired in favour of a stochastic-evidence (dynamic GRT) model that is still in validation, so RT output here should be treated as provisional and its architecture classification not relied upon.

inputs.name: rtq
inputs.note: 4 stimuli x 4 responses x 5 quantiles [.1 .3 .5 .7 .9], RAW SECONDS, 0.0 for empty cells

training.note: SUPERSEDED WEIGHTS, kept working while labelled honestly. These are the retired ballistic RT model (src/data/rt_lba_generator.py), not the dynamic-GRT replacement. Its five-way architecture output, including the 84.6% recovery figure, must not be cited as evidence for the replacement model: see docs/dynamic_grt_rt_design.md section 0 and section 6. The replacement has passed validation gates 1, 3 and 4; gate 2 misses its threshold in one condition and gates 5-8 have not been run, so no dynamic-GRT network has been trained. Treat all RT output here as experimental.
